description: Anomalix is a two-person team from São José do Rio Preto, Brazil. In statistics, an outlier is the data point that refuses to follow the pattern. That's us: two teenagers competing against the world. We turn NASA Earth data into clear, statistically honest answers about our changing climate - what is changing, where, by how much, and whether it's real signal or natural variation. We build tools that let anyone see the trend hiding inside the noise.
